function.arguments: {"verdict": "bug", "evidence": "With reduction=\"none\" and a non-uniform upstream gradient (randn, shape (BT,)), grad_input, grad_weight and grad_bias are all wrong. The forward loss matches the oracle. The cause is that the gradients are precomputed in the forward pass and only rescaled in backward. fused_linear_cross_entropy_backward calls element_mul_kernel, which loads a single scalar (tl.load(grad_output_ptr)). For reduction=\"none\" it therefore multiplies every row by grad_output[0] instead of by the per-token g_i.
